AssistantMessageEvent.description: Event protocol for AssistantMessageEventStream. Successful streams emit `start` before partial updates and terminate with `done`. A stream may terminate directly with `error` when request setup fails before generation starts; after `start`, failures also terminate with `error`. Direct `streamSimple()` calls throw synchronously when request auth is missing. Updates and `done` must never appear before `start`. `partial` is the shared live response-so-far helper, not an event-time snapshot. Text and thinking blocks are empty when their `*_start` event is emitted and grow only through their corresponding `*_delta` events until the authoritative `*_end`. Redacted thinking may be complete at start and emit no deltas. Tool-call arguments at `toolcall_start` are provider-specific; `toolcall_delta` carries subsequent JSON updates.

CustomEntry__unknown.description: Custom entry for extensions to store extension-specific data in the session. Use customType to identify your extension's entries. Purpose: Persist extension state across session reloads. On reload, extensions can scan entries for their customType and reconstruct internal state. Does NOT participate in LLM context (ignored by buildSessionContext). For injecting content into context, see CustomMessageEntry.

CustomMessage__unknown.description: Message type for extension-injected messages via sendMessage(). These are custom messages that extensions can inject into the conversation.

CustomMessageEntry__unknown.description: Custom message entry for extensions to inject messages into LLM context. Use customType to identify your extension's entries. Unlike CustomEntry, this DOES participate in LLM context. The content is converted to a user message in buildSessionContext(). Use details for extension-specific metadata (not sent to LLM). display controls TUI rendering: - false: hidden entirely - true: rendered with distinct styling (different from user messages)

schedule.description: One-shot schedule; null for engines created with "start now".

gateMode.description: Defaults to `auto` when omitted, which is what engines predating it used.

presetIds.description: Preset agents the commander may use; empty or omitted means no restriction.

schedule.description: When set, the engine is saved as scheduled instead of starting immediately.

tokenLimit.description: Total tokens per task; null means no token limit.

applied.description: Actions already applied, so a restarted scheduler never repeats them.

timezone.description: IANA zone of the operator when the plan was made; display only.

SentinelEngineScheduleAction.description: One step of a scheduled engineering run. The timeline is one-shot: the times are absolute epoch milliseconds, and `timezone` is carried only for display (the browser that created the plan, e.g. Asia/Shanghai).

SentinelEngineScheduleInput.description: Operator input for a schedule; the server fills phase/applied/finished fields.

SentinelEngineTarget.description: One line of the operator's target list: a target plus an optional note.

SentinelEngineTask.description: One task the commander dispatched. Executed by its own agent session.

attempt.description: Which dispatch attempt for its target this is; 1 is the first.

autoResume.description: The task was interrupted by a scheduled pause and should be continued on the next scheduled resume. A service restart clears this: safe restart policy leaves interruption recovery to the operator.

pendingContinue.description: A requested continuation that has not started yet. While it is set and the task is queued, the next worker reopens the task's own session file instead of starting a new conversation.

SentinelEngineTaskContinue.description: A commander-requested continuation waiting for a worker slot. It is stored on the task row, not in memory, so a service restart while it is queued does not silently drop the instruction.

criteria.description: Extra automatic rounds; empty means keep the goal's existing criteria.

instruction.description: What the worker should do next, on top of its existing conversation.

roundLimit.description: Additional continuation rounds to grant, not a total.

SentinelEngineTaskStatus.description: Lifecycle of one engine task. Paused means interrupted (e.g. a restart).

SentinelEnvItem.description: One environment prerequisite. `blocking` items decide whether the console runs at all: Docker is not optional here, because every tool call is a `docker exec` into a project container.

group.description: Section the item is listed under, e.g. Docker 运行时.

hint.description: What to do about a warn or fail.

at.description: ISO timestamp of the check that produced this report.

containerNetwork.description: Network mode new and rebuilt project containers are created with.

proxies.description: Proxy profiles as configured, for the environment page's summary.

sources.description: Build sources as configured (empty fields mean the official source).

url.description: Console address, shown in the environment page.

SentinelFileEntry.description: One directory entry in the container work directory.

SentinelFilePreview.description: Bounded inline view of one file.

SentinelForkPoint.description: A point the conversation can branch from.

SentinelGateApproval.description: Who let the call through. Every tool call lands in exactly one bucket: - `ai` the gatekeeper judged it — bash and droid_shell in AI 审批, plus MCP and plugin tools while the MCP switch is on. The only bucket with a verdict, a latency and a token cost. - `human` 审批模式: the operator approved or rejected it in the queue. - `auto` nobody looked: 自动执行 mode, an allow-listed prefix, or a tool the judge does not cover (read, edit, write, …). The audit page shows the first bucket as 「AI 审批」 and the other two as 「自动审批」, which together cover every call exactly once.

SentinelGateDecision.description: One gatekeeper judgment, as stored and as streamed to the console.

approval.description: Who let it through; see SentinelGateApproval.

at.description: Epoch milliseconds when the judgment started.

commandTruncated.description: The stored command was cut to the per-record cap.

error.description: Raw error text when the judgment could not be completed.

model.description: Endpoint that produced the verdict, e.g. "judge-stub".

modelFrom.description: Display name of the library entry the endpoint came from.

reason.description: The gatekeeper's BLOCK reason, or the failure text for `failed`.

source.description: Which agent issued it: 主代理 / 子代理 / 工程任务「X」.

SentinelGateDecisionKind.description: What the gatekeeper decided about one bash command. `failed` is deliberately separate from `allow`: a judgment that never arrived is allowed through, but it is a different event from the gatekeeper reading the command and clearing it, and the audit page has to keep them apart.

SentinelGateFilter.description: Audit list filters; every field is optional and they combine with AND.

approval.description: Which buckets to include. An array because the page's 「自动审批」 tab is two buckets at once (human + auto); an empty or absent list means all three.

concurrency.description: Judgments allowed in flight at once; 0 means no limit.

mode.description: Console-wide default mode; a session may override it.

timeoutMs.description: How long one judgment may take before it counts as a failure.

SentinelGatekeeperView.description: Live gatekeeper state carried in every snapshot.

failures.description: Judgments that failed and were allowed through.

judgeResolved.description: The endpoint the 守门模型 role resolves to; null when nothing resolves.

sessionOverride.description: The active session's own choice; null means it follows the global default.

SentinelGatePage.description: One page of audit records, newest first.

total.description: Records matching the filter, not the page size.

SentinelGateStats.description: Counts and cost figures for the audit page header.

blockRate.description: block / total, 0 when nothing was judged yet.

byApproval.description: Rows per approval bucket, so each tab can summarise itself.

failures.description: Judgments that ended in a failure (all of which were allowed through).

last24h.description: Judgments in the last 24 hours, so the page can show whether it is alive.

lastSuccessAt.description: When the judge last answered at all, block included.

totalTokens.description: Judge tokens spent; never counted into a session's own usage.

SentinelGoalBlocked.description: The blocker report that stopped a goal.

streak.description: Consecutive rounds the same blocker was reported.

SentinelGoalCompletion.description: The evidence a completed goal carries.

findingsNote.description: Required when nothing was submitted: why the run found nothing to report.

submitted.description: Findings submitted to the hub during this goal, as verified by the runtime.

SentinelGoalCriterionResult.description: One acceptance criterion with the verdict given at completion.

SentinelGoalProgress.description: What the model last reported through `goal_progress`.

SentinelGoalRound.description: One round of a goal: the initial run, or one automatic continuation.

index.description: 0 is the initial run; continuations count up from 1.

summary.description: Closing summary: what `goal_progress` said, or the round's last prose.

toolCalls.description: Tool calls the round made; zero for three rounds running trips the fuse.

SentinelGoalRoundKind.description: The initial run, or one automatic continuation.

SentinelGoalStatus.description: Lifecycle of a persistent goal. Only the model ends one successfully.

SentinelGoalUsage.description: Token and cost counters. Cost is null when the endpoint reports no price.

SentinelGoalView.description: A goal as the console shows it: the stored record plus live counters.

baseline.description: Usage when the goal started, so the bar can show what this goal cost.

blockerStreak.description: Consecutive rounds reporting the same blocker.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria; empty means the operator left them out.

noProgressStreak.description: Consecutive rounds without a tool call.

roundLimit.description: Automatic continuations allowed. The initial run is not counted.

running.description: Whether the goal's session has a run in flight right now.

subagent.description: Sub-agent work of this goal. Shown for context; it does not consume rounds.

submitted.description: Findings submitted to the hub while this goal ran.

usage.description: Main-agent usage since the goal started.

SentinelJudgeLoadReport.description: What the 守门模型 concurrency test measured: several judgments sent at once.

latencyMs.description: Time from sending to answering, over the judgments that succeeded. Absent when none did.

succeeded.description: Judgments that answered a verdict within the gatekeeper's timeout.

SentinelMcpConfigView.description: The whole custom-MCP configuration as the console sees it.

mounted.description: Servers a session mounts right now (enabled, acknowledged, and within the tool budget).

path.description: Config file the entries are stored in, shown on the page.

permissionOn.description: The 权限 → MCP switch. Off means no server is mounted at all.

SentinelMcpExposure.description: Exposure of a server's tools, as the MCP extension accepts it.

SentinelMcpServerView.description: One custom server as the settings screen shows it, editor fields included.

hostExecAcknowledged.description: stdio only: the operator accepted that the command runs on the console host. A server without it is stored but never mounted.

target.description: Command line for stdio, URL for http: the one-line summary of the row.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout in seconds; null means the extension's own default (60).

SentinelMcpStatus.description: The outcome of the last connection attempt, kept for the settings screen.

at.description: Epoch milliseconds of the attempt, or null when it was never connected.

error.description: Failure text as the connection or the transport reported it.

resources.description: Resources it listed at the last successful connect.

tools.description: Tools the server offered at the last successful connect.

SentinelMcpTestResult.description: One connection probe, with what the server offered when it answered.

detail.description: Technical detail, e.g. the response body excerpt or error cause.

instructions.description: Server instructions from `initialize`, when it sent any.

message.description: Human-readable summary in Chinese for direct display.

tools.description: Tool names the server offered, when it connected.

SentinelMcpToolGate.description: MCP tool judging: the gatekeeper's second entrance. bash is judged inside the bash tool, at the point where the command would enter the container. MCP tools — plugin tools included — have no such seam, so they are judged on the agent's `tool_call` event instead. The switch exists because every judged call costs one model round-trip: an operator who only cares about shell commands can leave it off, and one who wants plugins watched without the noise of every custom MCP server can narrow it further.

enabled.description: Judge MCP tool calls at all, in AI 审批 mode only.

includePlugins.description: Include plugin-host tools (server names `plugin-*`). Those are the ones that can drive managed hosts, so they are the most worth watching — and the noisiest, because a single plugin exposes dozens of tools.

SentinelMcpTransport.description: How a custom MCP server is reached. `stdio` spawns a command on the console host, outside the project container. `http` talks to a remote streamable-HTTP endpoint, and `sse` to the older HTTP+SSE one, where the server names the message endpoint on a long-lived stream.

SentinelMode.description: Who decides whether a bash command may run. `review` asks the operator, `ai` asks the gatekeeper model, `auto` runs it. `ai` is not a weaker `auto`: a judgment that fails is allowed through (so a dead endpoint cannot stall an unattended run), but a missing endpoint refuses the mode outright rather than silently degrading.

SentinelModelCapabilities.description: What pi needs to know about a model beyond its id. Absent fields fall back to pi's own defaults (128k context, 16k output, no reasoning, text only, no prices, no cache lifetime). `api` defaults to OpenAI Chat Completions.

defaultThinkingLevel.description: New sessions use this model-specific default, stored in SDK settings.

headers.description: Model-specific HTTP headers. Values are never returned to the browser.

thinkingLevelMap.description: Omitted preserves advanced settings; null clears a previous model's template.

SentinelModelCostRates.description: USD prices per million tokens, matching pi's model schema.

SentinelModelEntryView.description: One row of the model library as the settings screen sees it. The key itself is never sent to the client; `hasKey` only says whether one is stored.

customHeaders.description: Names only; request-header values can contain credentials.

roles.description: Roles currently pointing at this entry.

SentinelModelingState.description: Live state of the modeling run in the viewed session, if any.

SentinelModelLibraryView.description: The whole model screen: the library, the role assignments (entry id, or "follow-main" for judge/reviewer, or null for an unset main), and what each role currently resolves to.

SentinelModelPromptCache.description: Best-effort prompt cache lifetime in seconds, per retention tier.

SentinelModelRoleName.description: The jobs a model can be assigned to.

SentinelNotifyChannel.description: Notification settings shared by the server and browser. Groups apply globally.

summaryLimit.description: Characters kept per body section; 0 keeps all, subject to platform limits.

SentinelOfficialPluginView.description: One bundled official plugin, as listed before installation.

sizeBytes.description: Zip size, for the "why is this slow" hint.

SentinelOpenVpn.description: One OpenVPN tunnel. The configuration is pasted whole — a provider hands out a single `.ovpn` with the certificates inlined, and that file already carries the cipher, the remote and the routes. The console adds what a file cannot say: the credentials for `auth-user-pass` (kept out of the pasted text and mounted as their own file), the resolver the container should use when the pasted file names none, and whether to drop the direct default route once the tunnel is up.

config.description: The `.ovpn` as pasted, inline certificates and all.

dns.description: Resolver for the container; empty falls back to the `dhcp-option DNS` the server pushes.

killSwitch.description: Remove the direct default route after the tunnel is up.

username.description: Username for `auth-user-pass`; empty means the configuration needs none.

SentinelPermissionPreset.description: One-click permission bundles offered above the switches.

plugins.description: Per-plugin mount switches, one set per agent.

subagentMaxTurns.description: Turn budget before one sub-agent run is aborted.

SentinelPermissionSet.description: The switches of one agent. Missing entries mean "not allowed".

SentinelPluginArtifact.description: One file under a plugin's artifacts directory.

SentinelPluginBuild.description: How the plugin host builds the image from the uploaded package. Paths are relative to the directory that contains `plugin.json`.

args.description: Optional --build-arg values, e.g. a mirror for the base image.

context.description: Build context, relative to the plugin root.

default.description: Pre-filled value; `null` means the field starts empty.

SentinelPluginHostInput.description: Add or edit one host. `id` present means edit.

token.description: Empty on an edit keeps the stored token.

SentinelPluginHostView.description: A plugin host as the console lists it. The token is never part of the view: saving a host without one keeps the stored token.

local.description: Discovered from a `plugin-host --local` state file on this machine.

SentinelPluginLocality.description: Where a plugin makes sense. `local-only` covers anything that needs the operator's own network vantage (LAN scanning, local capture); `remote-only` covers anything that needs a clean public egress or a long-lived public address. The host refuses a mismatched install instead of starting something that cannot work.

ui.description: Null when the plugin ships no frontend.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request budget of an MCP call, in milliseconds.

startupTimeoutMs.description: How long the host waits for the health endpoint while the container starts.

SentinelPluginPermissionMap.description: One agent's per-plugin switches, keyed by `${hostId}/${pluginId}`. These are not tool switches: a plugin is an MCP server, so the only useful granularity is "may this agent mount it". An absent key means allowed, which is the behaviour every install had before this page listed plugins at all — installing a plugin mounted it, and turning it off is the explicit act.

capAdd.description: Extra Linux capabilities, e.g. `NET_RAW` for a scanner that needs raw sockets.

memory.description: Docker size string, lower case, e.g. `512m` or `2g`.

SentinelPluginState.description: Runtime state of one installed plugin, as the host reports it.

SentinelPluginsView.description: Everything the plugin center page renders.

problems.description: Hosts that did not answer, one line each.

SentinelPluginToolHint.description: A tool as advertised before install; the running MCP server remains authoritative.

entry.description: Container path of the entry document, e.g. `/ui/index.html`.

protocol.description: Bridge protocol; only 1 is understood for now.

sidebar.description: Author's suggestion to offer a sidebar entry; the operator still opts in.

title.description: Title shown in the console's frame around the iframe.

SentinelPluginUiSidebar.description: The optional frontend. The console serves the plugin's `/ui/` files behind a sandboxed iframe; `entry` is the container path of the HTML document and every other asset is resolved relative to it.

icon.description: Icon under /ui/, e.g. `/ui/icon.svg`; empty falls back to the generic icon.

label.description: Sidebar label; falls back to the UI title or plugin name.

SentinelPluginView.description: One installed plugin on one host.

configured.description: Config keys that have a stored value.

enabled.description: The console-side switch; off means its tools are not mounted.

pinned.description: Pinned to the console sidebar by the operator.

values.description: Stored values of non-secret fields; secrets only appear in `configured`.

SentinelPoc.description: One imported Nuclei template. The library is read-only for the agent: the yaml never enters the project container, and the only agent-facing tools (poc_search / poc_read) hand back text. Firing a template means writing your own yaml into the working directory and running nuclei on it via bash.

id.description: The template's own `info.id`, which imports dedupe on.

references.description: CVE ids extracted at import time.

sourceFile.description: File the template was imported from.

SentinelPocFilters.description: List filters; every field is optional and they combine with AND.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on id, name, tags and CVE ids.

replaced.description: Templates whose id already existed and were overwritten.

SentinelPocSource.description: One subscription source: a zip URL the operator subscribes to. Sync only upserts (by template id) and never deletes — the library grows, and removing a template stays a manual decision.

headerName.description: Optional single auth header (e.g. Authorization). Present = one is set; the value itself never leaves the server.

headerSet.description: True when the stored source carries a header value.

history.description: Recent sync outcomes, newest first (bounded server-side).

intervalHours.description: Hours between automatic syncs; 0 = manual only.

lastResult.description: Newest outcome, mirrored at the top of `history`.

SentinelPocSourceSave.description: Save payload: `id` absent creates a source; an empty header value keeps the stored one.

SentinelPocSummary.description: A template without its yaml, for lists.

id.description: The template's own `info.id`, which imports dedupe on.

references.description: CVE ids extracted at import time.

sourceFile.description: File the template was imported from.

SentinelPocSyncRecord.description: One sync outcome kept on the source.

trigger.description: "manual" = operator clicked; "auto" = the interval timer fired.

SentinelPresetView.description: A preset as the settings screen needs it: metadata plus the loaded body.

placeholder.description: The composer's idle hint while this preset is in force, e.g. "说说这次要 看的目标". Empty means the console's default text. It is metadata for the operator, not context: it never reaches the model.

textMissing.description: The body file is gone; the entry is unusable until the operator rewrites it.

tokens.description: Rough token cost of `text`, so a huge preset is visible before it is used.

assetCount.description: Inventory assets recorded for this project, for the same reason.

container.description: Docker container executing this project's tools.

gateCount.description: Gatekeeper judgments recorded for this project, for the same reason.

manualStop.description: The operator stopped this container on purpose, so it needs an explicit start.

proxyId.description: Proxy this project's container is created with: absent follows the default on the 代理 page, `null` means no proxy, an id names a profile.

proxyName.description: Name of the profile that id resolves to, for the row's tag.

proxyNode.description: The node of that profile's subscription, when the project pins one. Absent follows the profile's own choice, which is what most projects do.

proxyNodeName.description: Name of the node that will actually be used, resolved; null when there is none.

sessionCount.description: Sessions recorded for this project, counted from the session directory.

state.description: Docker's view of the container: absent when there is no container at all.

storage.description: Cached project disk usage; absent while the first scan is running.

vulnCount.description: Findings recorded for this project, so its deletion can state what it takes.

SentinelProxy.description: One named proxy, managed on the 代理 page. A profile always describes something that runs — "no proxy" is a project's choice, not a profile.

nodes.description: Cached nodes; only a subscription profile has any.

nodeTag.description: Which node the generated selector defaults to.

skipped.description: Why the nodes of the last parse were skipped, for the picker.

test.description: Absent until the profile has been tested.

SentinelProxyConfigView.description: Everything the 代理 page renders.

defaultId.description: Proxy a project follows when it has no choice of its own; null means new projects start without one.

image.description: Image every sidecar runs, whatever profile it uses.

imagePresent.description: Whether that image is present locally.

testUrl.description: URL the batch latency test fetches through each node.

SentinelProxyInput.description: One profile as the page saves it; `id` absent creates a new one.

nodeTag.description: Which cached node the profile should use; empty picks the first.

subscriptionIntervalHours.description: Re-read every N hours; 0 turns the timer off.

subscriptionUrl.description: Subscription URL and user agent; the nodes themselves are fetched here.

SentinelProxyNode.description: One node of a subscription, already translated into a sing-box outbound. Stored, not recomputed: the console must be able to write a sidecar configuration on a machine that cannot reach the provider, and the parse is a guess that the operator may want to correct by hand later.

latencyMs.description: Round trip through this node to the test URL, in milliseconds; null when the request did not come back. Absent until the node has been tested.

name.description: What the provider called it, for the picker.

protocol.description: The sing-box outbound type, for the picker.

tag.description: Unique inside the profile; it is what the selector and the route name.

SentinelProxySubscription.description: Where a subscription profile's nodes come from, and how the last read went.

error.description: Why the last read failed, or null when it did not.

intervalHours.description: Re-read every N hours; 0 turns the timer off.

updatedAt.description: When the nodes were last read successfully; 0 means never.

userAgent.description: Sent as `User-Agent`; providers switch format on it.

SentinelProxyTest.description: The last connectivity test of one profile: whether traffic actually reached the test URL through that exit. Stored rather than kept in the page: the question "is this proxy still working" is asked once and then read many times, and a result that disappears on reload would have to be paid for with another container every time.

error.description: Why it failed, or null when it worked.

latencyMs.description: Round trip in milliseconds; null when the request did not come back.

url.description: The URL traffic was sent to; kept so an old result is never read as a new one.

SentinelResolvedModelView.description: What a role resolves to right now, so the screen can show the effective endpoint.

followedMain.description: True when the role resolved through 主模型 instead of its own entry.

SentinelSessionEngineRef.description: Which engineering task a session belongs to, for the sidebar's engine badge.

SentinelSessionPresetView.description: The preset agent a session was created with, as the console shows it. `null` on the snapshot means the session runs the plain default agent.

missing.description: The preset is gone or its body file is missing: the session runs the default agent.

name.description: The current name; falls back to the id when the preset was deleted.

placeholder.description: The preset's composer hint; empty when it has none, or when the preset is gone.

SentinelSimpleProxy.description: A SOCKS5 or HTTP endpoint, the whole of what `simple` mode needs.

tls.description: HTTPS upstream for `http`; ignored by SOCKS5.

SentinelSources.description: Base image and package mirrors for the toolbox image build. Empty means the official source; the values are baked into the image at build time.

SentinelStateSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the runtime state sent on connect and after state changes.

allowedPrefixes.description: Command prefixes (first word) auto-approved this session, e.g. ["nmap"].

availableThinkingLevels.description: Levels the active model accepts, in ascending effort order.

compacting.description: Compaction (or branch summarization) is running for the active session. It blocks prompts, and a slow model can hold it for minutes, so the console has to show it and offer a way out.

compactionStartedAt.description: When the current compaction started, for the elapsed time; null when idle.

droidEnabled.description: Whether the viewed conversation mounts the Android toolset (per session).

gatekeeper.description: Which mode applies and how the gatekeeper model is doing.

goal.description: Persistent goal of the active session, with live counters; null when there is none.

iosEnabled.description: Whether the viewed conversation mounts the iOS toolset (per session).

messages.description: Serialized AgentMessage[] for the active session.

modeling.description: The business-modeling run in the active session, with live counters; null when this session is not modeling. The modeling tools are only mounted while this is set, so the console can state whether they are available.

modelingAttached.description: Modeling records the operator attached to the active session from the composer (带建模数据); empty when none. While set, the read-only `api_model_read` is mounted so the model can read the full documents.

pendingApprovals.description: Bash commands awaiting an operator decision, oldest first.

preset.description: The preset agent the active session was created with; null means the default agent.

project.description: Active project; null means no project is selected and the chat is unavailable.

reportsEnabled.description: Whether the viewed conversation has opted into report submission and evidence tools.

runningSessions.description: Session ids with an active run (background included).

sessionStatus.description: Operator status of the active session, as a label the agent never sees.

subagents.description: Sub-agent runs of the active session, newest first, without their process steps.

subagentTotal.description: Total runs of the active session; `subagents` is only the newest page.

supervisor.description: Supervision of the viewed conversation; null when it was never armed.

supervisorConfig.description: Global supervision settings shown under 设置 → 模型.

thinkingLevel.description: Reasoning effort for the active session; "off" when the model has no reasoning.

SentinelSubagentEvent.description: One normalized step of a sub-agent's process, in order.

durationMs.description: How long the call ran, on `tool_end` only; lets the panel show a slow step.

from.description: Set on commander `text` events typed by the operator, for the chat feed.

truncated.description: Set when the stored payload exceeded the per-step cap and was cut down.

SentinelSubagentRun.description: A sub-agent run: live state plus the summary retained in the history list.

events.description: Buffered process steps; only sent for one run on demand, never in a snapshot.

SentinelSupervisorAdvice.description: One intervention record, whether auto-sent or awaiting operator confirmation.

SentinelSupervisorAdviceDraft.description: What the supervisor asks the main agent to do; only intervene mode sends it.

SentinelSupervisorAuditItem.description: One global-audit row in 工作台 → 监督.

strategies.description: Every selected strategy; older persisted sessions omit it.

pendingAdvice.description: Sessions with at least one pending advice.

SentinelSupervisorCall.description: Compact observation of one tool call; full output stays in the session file.

newEvidence.description: A new endpoint, parameter, or tool-reported finding landed on this call.

SentinelSupervisorConfig.description: Global settings shown under 设置 → 模型.

customStrategies.description: Global operator-defined strategies, available in every project.

defaultCustomStrategyId.description: When set, a new conversation defaults to this custom strategy.

defaultStrategies.description: Ordered default selection for a new conversation; can contain several strategies.

defaultStrategy.description: Default for a new conversation; the operator can override it before arming.

enabled.description: Master switch; the per-conversation arm remains the actual gate.

SentinelSupervisorCustomStrategy.description: One operator-defined strategy: a named overlay on top of a base preset.

description.description: Short line shown in the picker.

instructions.description: Extra focus/advice guidance; cannot relax safety rules.

SentinelSupervisorDelivery.description: How a pending intervention is delivered when the mode is intervene.

SentinelSupervisorEpisode.description: One structured episode produced from a batch of calls.

SentinelSupervisorLog.description: One supervisor log line, kept for the floating window and the audit detail.

SentinelSupervisorMode.description: Two operator-visible modes. Both only observe; intervention never blocks.

SentinelSupervisorState.description: The rolling state, merged deterministically from episodes.

SentinelSupervisorStrategy.description: How the supervisor weights its attention; never relaxes safety rules.

SentinelSupervisorStrategyEntry.description: A resolved strategy snapshot carried with a live view or an audit row.

SentinelSupervisorStrategyRef.description: A strategy selected for one conversation: a preset base or a saved custom strategy.

SentinelSupervisorTested.description: One endpoint/test pair the supervisor inferred from an episode.

SentinelSupervisorView.description: Live view of one supervised conversation, carried in the snapshot and pushed live.

logs.description: Latest supervisor log lines, so a reopened window is not blank.

strategies.description: Every selected strategy; older persisted sessions omit it.

SentinelTerminalSession.description: The operator's shell in a project container. Each project keeps its shell alive when that project's panel closes.

code.description: Exit code once the shell is gone; null while it runs.

SentinelTestResult.description: Result of probing an endpoint configuration without saving it.

detail.description: Technical detail, e.g. the response body excerpt or error cause.

message.description: Human-readable summary in Chinese for direct display.

SentinelToolInfo.description: One mounted tool of the live session, listed on the permissions screen so the operator can check what the switches actually produced.

active.description: Whether the model sees it right now (as opposed to codemode/deferred only).

source.description: Where the tool came from, e.g. "base", "extension", "sdk", "mcp".

SentinelUsageTotals.description: Usage retained across sessions, projects and service restarts.

SentinelVulnCategory.description: Coarse vulnerability class the judge must pick for a security verdict: web (injection, XSS, SSRF, auth bypass, path traversal, …), memory (overflow, OOB, UAF, double free, …) or other (crypto, DoS, info leak, …). Drives the activity filter and the per-monitor auto-dispatch allowlist.

assetLabel.description: Asset label snapshot, so the hub can show it after the asset is gone.

number.description: Sequence within the project, starting at 1.

path.description: Absolute path inside the project container (/work/...), previewed in place.

SentinelVulnFilters.description: List filters; every field is optional and they combine with AND.

assetId.description: Exact inventory asset the finding is linked to.

dubious.description: Only records the reviewer marked as dubious (hallucination suspects).

engineId.description: Exact engineering engine (工程) the finding came from.

ids.description: Restrict to selected records; an empty selection matches nothing.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on label, title, category, description and source.

sessionId.description: Exact session the finding was submitted from.

severity.description: Match any selected level; omitted or empty means all levels.

target.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the affected target.

taskId.description: Exact engineering task inside that engine.

SentinelVulnNote.description: One entry of a finding's timeline: a status change or a free-text remark.

SentinelVulnReview.description: The dedicated reviewer LLM's verdict on one finding.

agentSeverity.description: The agent's own rating, kept beside the reviewer's verdict. The record carries these numbers until the reviewer rules — and keeps them after a failed review — so the console can say 「自评」 instead of presenting an unverified number as a calibrated one.

error.description: Failure reason, present when state is "failed".

model.description: Which model produced the verdict, e.g. "gpt-4o-mini".

reason.description: One-paragraph justification, always in Chinese for the operator.

severity.description: The reviewer's own rating, present when state is "done".

state.description: queued = waiting for the reviewer; done = verdict applied; failed = endpoint/parse error; skipped = operator acted first.

verdict.description: solid = evidence supports the finding; dubious = it does not (hallucination suspects).

SentinelVulnSeverity.description: Severity buckets of the vulnerability hub.

SentinelVulnStats.description: Counts for the hub page header.

SentinelVulnStatus.description: Lifecycle of one finding. The agent always creates `pending`; only the operator moves a record on from there, because a finding the model believes in is still a hypothesis until someone reproduces it.

SentinelVulnSummary.description: A finding without its heavy fields, for the list and for the agent's query.

SentinelWebSearchKeyInput.description: Add or update one pool key. An absent id adds; a replaced key un-verifies it.

key.description: null keeps the stored secret; omitted on add is an error.

SentinelWebSearchKeyView.description: Web-search (Tavily) key-pool configuration. Unlike the asset platforms, the pool holds many keys of one provider and rotates them by remaining credits, so the view is a list rather than a fixed platform row.

tail.description: Last 4 characters of the stored key, so rows can be told apart.

usage.description: Credits left and the cap they relate to, when a usage probe has run.

SentinelWireGuard.description: One WireGuard tunnel. The configuration is pasted whole — that is what a provider hands out, and it carries keys, address, MTU, keepalive and the peer in the spelling `wg-quick` already understands. The console adds only the two decisions that are not in the file: the resolver the container should use (Docker's own resolver runs outside the tunnel, so leaving it unset would leak every lookup) and whether to drop the direct default route once the tunnel is up.

dns.description: Resolver for the container; empty uses the file's own `DNS =` line.

killSwitch.description: Remove the direct default route after the tunnel is up.

SessionEntry.description: Session entry - has id/parentId for tree structure (returned by "read" methods in SessionManager)

SessionInfoEntry.description: Session metadata entry (e.g., user-defined display name).

SessionTreeNode.description: Tree node for getTree() - defensive copy of session structure

label.description: Resolved label for this entry, if any

labelTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the latest label change for this entry, if any

SystemMessage.description: System instructions and tool declarations at one point in the transcript. The leading system message is the system prompt. Later system messages change it: `content` adds instructions from that point on, `sections` replace or remove named prompt sections, and `toolsAdded`/`toolsRemoved` change the tool set. Replaying every system message in order yields the current prompt and tools. Providers that accept system messages mid-conversation send each one in place; other providers rebuild the leading system message from the replayed state.

content.description: Instruction text. On the leading message this is the base prompt; later, additional instructions.

sections.description: Named, ordered prompt sections rendered verbatim after `content`. The leading message declares them; later messages replace sections by name, and `null` removes one. Keep each section self-delimiting (a tag, a heading) so the model can relate an update to the original. Avoid integer-like names; JSON objects reorder those.

toolsAdded.description: Complete definitions of tools that become available at this point.

toolsRemoved.description: Tools that stop being available at this point.

redacted.description: When true, the thinking content was redacted by safety filters. The opaque encrypted payload is stored in `thinkingSignature` so it can be passed back to the API for multi-turn continuity.

ThinkingLevel.description: Thinking/reasoning level for models that support it. Note: "xhigh" and "max" are only supported by selected model families. Use model thinking-level metadata from

namespace.description: OpenAI Responses namespace for calls to dynamically loaded or namespaced tools.

UiLanguage.description: Language primitives shared by the browser console and the server. Messages are keyed by their Chinese source text. That keeps call sites readable (`t("保存")`) and makes a missing translation fall back to the source instead of rendering a key. `{name}` placeholders are filled by the caller, so translators can move them without touching code.

cacheWrite1h.description: Subset of `cacheWrite` written with 1h retention. Only Anthropic reports this split.

reasoning.description: Reasoning/thinking tokens, when the provider reports them. This is a subset of `output`: `output` already includes these tokens. Set to a number (possibly 0) by providers that expose a reasoning breakdown; left undefined by providers that don't.

note.description: Optional human-readable qualifier for usage notices.

target.description: Cached origin; its protocol is the HTTPS selection. Host is resolved again before sending.

WebFuzzRoute.description: Manual HTTP replay. Routes always refer to the current project.

target.description: Cached origin; its protocol is the HTTPS selection. Host is resolved again before sending.

entryId.description: The original session entry or engineering event; never a model-produced locator.

intentQuote.description: Exact, verified wording retained for subsequent updates of an explicit intent.

batchSize.description: Learned after output truncation; persisted so retries do not repeat an oversized batch.

consumed.description: Fingerprints of consumed records, keyed by immutable evidence id.

retry.description: Persisted retry schedule, including history-only runs, cleared by pause or success.

WorkProcessKind.description: Evidence-backed, read-only reconstructions of conversations and engineering runs.

monitorId.description: An existing monitor lets the server reuse its stored token.

allowBuild.description: Explicit consent to run the Dockerfile on the plugin host.

package.description: The uploaded zip, base64. The host extracts and builds it.

category.description: Optional vuln-category narrowing on top of the status filter.

attachModelIds.description: Modeling records to attach to this fresh conversation (带建模数据). Honored only for a conversation that has no messages yet, and only on this one prompt; their catalog is injected before the text runs.

capabilities.description: When present this is the complete capability declaration: fields the object omits are cleared. Omitted entirely means "keep what is stored".

placeholder.description: The composer hint while this preset is active; omitted or empty keeps the default.

criteria.description: One criterion per line; empty means the operator left them out.

customStrategyId.description: Set when the operator picked a saved custom strategy.

note.description: Optional operator note, capped at 200 characters.

strategies.description: Multiple selections; takes precedence over the legacy singular fields.

total.description: Matches for the current filter, not the page size.

detail.description: Extra outcome line, e.g. how many commits a check consumed.

enabled.description: The viewed conversation's switch; device and token lists are global.

lanIps.description: Non-internal IPv4 addresses of the server, for the listen picker.

listen.description: The dedicated reverse listener, when it is bound.

listenConfig.description: What the operator picked (may differ from `listen` when it failed to bind).

tabCounts.description: Rows per approval bucket, with every filter but `approval` applied. The tab strip is navigation, not a result: its counts must not collapse to zero for the tab that is not selected, which is what happens when the tab's own approval filter is left in.

certPin.description: SHA-256 of the console's leaf certificate, for wss pinning.

enabled.description: The viewed conversation's switch; device and token lists are global.

load.description: What the run measured, when the test sent more than one judgment.

raw.description: The raw one-line answer, when one judgment actually came back.
